newsitem.title: USA: Firm seeks to up Crop Growers take to 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Firm seeks to up Crop Growers take to 25 pct.

text.p: Kramer Spellman L.P. said it notified the insurance commissioner of Kansas of its plan to raise its stake in Crop Growers to as much as 25 percent.
It said the plan is connection with its intention to acquire control of three affiliates of Crop Growers, namely, Plains Insurance Co Inc, McPherson Hail Insurance Co and Farmers Hail Insurance Co.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership said such acquisition will be effected through open market purchases of as yet undetermined number of Crop Growers' common shares that would give it ownership of 25 percent of the company's outstanding common stock.
The Fort Lee, N.J.,-based partnership currently holds a 9.89 percent stake or 805,700 common shares in Crop Growers, the nation's second largest servicer of crop insurance.
